title: Bridging Oncology and Autoimmune Disease: Using QSP to Select T-Cell Engager Doses by CRS Risk and Efficacy
summary: Explore how QSP modeling informs T-cell engager dose selection for autoimmune diseases, balancing efficacy and cytokine release syndrome risk.

### Advance T-Cell Engager Development with QSP Modeling


Explore how Certara’s quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) expertise can help optimize T-cell engager development, from first-in-human dose selection and step-up dosing strategies to balancing efficacy with cytokine release syndrome (CRS) risk. Learn how mechanistic modeling can support safer, more informed clinical development decisions.


[Explore QSP Modeling Services](https://www.certara.com/services/quantitative-systems-pharmacology/)
